advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.title: Field Project Technician
advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.description: Founded in 1985, ATS is a company with a presence in the United States, Mexico and the United Kingdom. We are professionals in Industrial Maintenance and we make factories run better. Fundada en 1985, ATS es una empresa con presencia en los Estados Unidos, México y el Reino Unido. Somos profesionales en mantenimiento industrial y hacemos que las fábricas funcionen mejor. Principal Duties/Responsibilities: · Performs entry to mid-level break-fix & preventative maintenance. This includes but not limited to: adjusting functional parts of devices and control instruments to sustain and improve operations; repairing or replacing defective parts; reconditioning or repairing machine tools. · Identifies needed parts, supplies, and repair items. · Provides support and back up for other members of department as needed by leadership. · Is aware of Maintenance Industry Standards. · Assures compliance with 5S and housekeeping standards. · Participates in CI activities - processes, results and cost savings. · May be required to setup and operate simple machining operations including but not limited to: lathe, drill press, grinder, and other metalworking tools to make and repair parts. May perform basic welding tasks. · Updates records and reviews CMMS history. · Performs basic troubleshooting of control systems circuitry. · Completes technical self-study programs for career development. · Follows all safety related policies, rules, regulations, technical instructions and guidelines. Situational awareness and identify unsafe behaviors and conditions. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, & Behaviors Required: · High School Graduate or equivalent (GED). · Associates degree with a Technical focus or 18 months of related experience in general industry or successful completion of the ATS Technician Progression Program. · Understanding of basic electrical and mechanical systems. Can perform repairs. · Must be able to use basic hand tools. Physical Demands and Working Conditions: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands/fingers to handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb, ascend/descend or balance to heights that may require a ladder or lift; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl in confined spaces; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move more than 50 pounds. The employee is regularly required to use close vision and color vision. The employee is occasionally exposed to outside weather conditions and risk of electrical shock. Work is typically performed in a factory environment and is usually very loud. In the factory environment, the employee may be exposed to hazardous materials and/or greasy or slippery factory floors. ​ ATS believes in fair and equitable pay. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. We also offer market leading benefit programs including Medical, Dental and Vision plans, PTO, a 401k retirement plans with employer matching, tuition reimbursement, and more. Pay Range $24.83 — $31.76 USD ATS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment to all applicants and employees without regard to age, color, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or other legally protected status. farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:4f8ecde7-e4.title: Salesforce Developer
farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:4f8ecde7-e4.description: Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. PORTO Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals. TECHNOLOGY The Technology team builds end-to-end products and solutions that power our marketplace, delivering an incredible experience for customers globally. From understanding customer and partner needs to designing and testing innovative hypotheses, we create industry-leading experiences for luxury customers everywhere. THE ROLE We're looking for a Salesforce Developer to join our Automation & CRM team. Reporting to the Engineering Lead, you will build and maintain our Salesforce platform. In this role, you will write custom code using Apex and LWC, build system integrations, and support our existing platform features. You will turn business requirements into technical solutions and handle the testing and code reviews for your deployments. You will also work directly with internal teams to understand their technical problems and deliver clear, scalable solutions.
responsibilities: Participate in the full development lifecycle, including design, development, testing,  code review and deployment;
Write custom code using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and object-oriented programming;
Ensure the best engineering practices when building solutions;
Write clean, scalable, and well-documented code, following platform rules and industry standards;
Collaborate with product managers, administrators, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions;
Provide technical support to fix system bugs, resolve issues, and improve platform performance.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:05088cc5-c545-.title: Senior Support Operations Lead
jobgether-jobgether:lever:05088cc5-c545-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Support Operations Lead based in United States. This role will shape and improve complex customer support journeys across a growing, technology-enabled support ecosystem. You’ll focus on turning high-friction operational challenges into scalable workflows, tools, and processes that improve customer experiences. Warranty replacements will be an important initial focus, spanning intake, eligibility, fulfillment, returns, and follow-up communications. You’ll combine journey design, analytics, root-cause analysis, and program management to identify opportunities and drive measurable improvements. The role requires close collaboration across Support, Product, Engineering, Fraud, Finance, Logistics, and Analytics teams. You’ll also create executive-ready recommendations, operational documentation, and change-management resources that enable teams to execute consistently. This is an impactful opportunity for an experienced operations leader who thrives at the intersection of customer experience, systems, data, and process transformation. Design and optimize end-to-end customer journeys across complex support experiences, with an initial emphasis on warranty replacements and related post-purchase processes. Identify friction across intake, eligibility, decision-making, fulfillment, returns, and follow-up communications, then translate findings into improved workflows. Develop future-state processes, decision trees, routing logic, requirements, and operational guardrails that improve consistency, efficiency, and customer outcomes. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Member Experience, Product, Engineering, Fraud, Finance, Logistics, and related teams to align priorities and implement effective solutions. Lead root-cause analysis of recurring operational issues by combining data from support platforms, transactional systems, logistics environments, and reporting tools. Investigate automation drop-offs, process exceptions, queue health challenges, return authorization and service-order quality issues, and market- or channel-specific breakdowns. Define and monitor KPIs, dashboards, and experimentation plans that measure customer effort, operational efficiency, quality, and risk. Lead cross-functional improvement programs from problem definition through implementation, managing scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder alignment. Maintain and prioritize an operational improvement roadmap that balances immediate opportunities with longer-term investments in tooling, reporting, and process quality. Coordinate launch readiness for new workflows, policy changes, and tooling updates, including communications, decision documentation, and post-launch monitoring. Prepare executive-level presentations, business cases, and operational updates that clearly communicate problems, data, trade-offs, recommendations, and expected outcomes. Create SOPs, playbooks, training materials, and operational guidance that improve execution quality and reduce dependence on informal knowledge. Partner with quality, training, and operations teams to identify recurring errors, improve adoption of new processes, and ensure operational changes remain effective over time. Requirements 8+ years of experience in support operations, customer experience operations, process improvement, program management, or a similar discipline within a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated expertise in customer journey design, with the ability to turn complex operational challenges into scalable workflows, routing logic, and support processes. Strong analytical and root-cause problem-solving skills, including the ability to work across multiple data sources and use operational metrics to guide decisions. Proven project management and prioritization capabilities, with experience managing multiple workstreams, aligning stakeholders

jobgether-jobgether:lever:3d547e9b-0666-.title: Strategic Account Executive: Life Sciences
jobgether-jobgether:lever:3d547e9b-0666-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Strategic Account Executive: Life Sciences based in the United States. This is a high-impact enterprise sales opportunity focused on accelerating growth across the life sciences sector. You will own revenue generation across strategic medical device, pharmaceutical, and biotechnology accounts, managing the full sales cycle from pipeline development through close. The role combines consultative selling, deep industry knowledge, executive relationship building, and the ability to translate complex clinical and technical capabilities into compelling business value. You will engage stakeholders across Clinical Affairs, Medical Affairs, R&D, Evidence Generation, Digital Health, and commercial teams. As a key member of a growing commercial organization, you will help build repeatable sales processes and shape the market strategy for an innovative healthcare technology. This role is ideal for an entrepreneurial sales leader who thrives on opening doors, navigating complex buying environments, and closing high-value partnerships. Own and deliver quarterly and annual revenue targets for the Life Sciences vertical. Build, develop, and manage a portfolio of strategic accounts across medical device, pharmaceutical, and biotechnology organizations. Manage the complete enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and opportunity development through negotiation and close. Develop account strategies that align technical and clinical capabilities with customers' evidence-generation, clinical, regulatory, and commercial priorities. Identify, engage, and expand relationships with senior decision-makers and champions across Clinical Affairs, Medical Affairs, R&D, Evidence Generation, Digital Health, and commercial functions. Translate complex clinical and technical capabilities into compelling value propositions for scientific, clinical, executive, and business audiences. Structure and negotiate phased commercial engagements, including initial pilots, evidence-generation programs, and broader enterprise partnerships. Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder procurement processes involving clinical, legal, security, procurement, executive, and other internal teams. Maintain strong CRM discipline, accurate pipeline management, and rigorous sales forecasting. Monitor market developments and competitive intelligence and communicate relevant insights to leadership. Partner cross-functionally to refine market positioning and translate customer feedback and field learnings into product and commercial strategy. Represent the organization at relevant life sciences conferences and industry events to generate qualified opportunities and strengthen market presence. Travel up to 30% for customer meetings, industry events, conferences, and strategic engagements. Requirements: 8+ years of enterprise sales experience, with a demonstrated track record selling technology solutions to medical device, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology companies. Proven history of exceeding revenue quotas and closing complex, high-value enterprise deals within the life sciences sector. Established relationships with senior executives and decision-makers across Clinical Affairs, R&D, Medical Affairs, Evidence Generation, or commercial functions. Deep understanding of life sciences commercialization across medical devices, pharmaceuticals, and biotechnology. Strong knowledge of R&D workflows, clinical development, real-world evidence, post-market studies, and the regulatory and reimbursement landscape. Experience navigating lengthy procurement cycles, complex stakeholder structures, and enterprise buying processes within large, matrixed organizations. Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility with both scientific and business audiences. Strong consultative selling, negotiation, account strategy, and relationship-building

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5692c7b5-927f-.title: CSV Lead
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5692c7b5-927f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a CSV Lead based in Netherlands. This role offers an opportunity to lead Computer System Validation and compliance activities across complex pharmaceutical manufacturing environments. You will provide validation leadership for computerized manufacturing and laboratory systems throughout their full lifecycle. The position combines hands-on CSV expertise with risk management, documentation oversight, and regulatory compliance guidance. You will partner closely with Quality, Engineering, Automation, IT/OT, laboratory, and project stakeholders. Your expertise will help ensure systems remain compliant with GxP requirements and applicable regulatory expectations. The role is well suited to an experienced validation professional who can work independently and confidently challenge project teams when needed. You will contribute directly to the successful delivery of capital and strategic projects within a highly regulated industry. Lead CSV and compliance activities for capital and strategic projects involving computerized manufacturing and laboratory systems. Plan, execute, review, and approve validation lifecycle activities and documentation in accordance with GxP requirements, internal procedures, and regulatory expectations. Provide expert guidance on CSV/CSA, SDLC, risk-based validation, system qualification, IQ/OQ/PQ, change control, configuration management, CAPA, deviations, and data integrity. Conduct and review system risk assessments, define appropriate validation strategies, and ensure identified compliance risks have effective mitigation plans. Maintain compliance oversight throughout system implementation, modification, operation, and retirement. Collaborate with Quality, Engineering, Automation, IT/OT, laboratory, business, and project teams to integrate validation requirements throughout project delivery. Support regulatory inspections, internal audits, remediation initiatives, and other compliance activities when required. Promote consistent, risk-based CSV/CSA practices across manufacturing projects and computerized systems. Contribute validation and qualification expertise across systems such as DeltaV Distributed Control Systems, Rockwell or Siemens PLCs, process historians, laboratory automation, and other GxP-regulated manufacturing platforms. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience, with strong hands-on Computer System Validation experience in GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or manufacturing environments. Demonstrated experience supporting validation and compliance activities for computerized manufacturing systems. Strong knowledge of validation lifecycle management, CSV/CSA principles, GxP/GMP requirements, SDLC, IQ/OQ/PQ, change control, CAPA, deviation management, risk-based validation, risk management, and data integrity. Proven ability to develop, review, and approve validation documentation and other compliance deliverables. Understanding of FDA, EMA, and international regulatory expectations applicable to computerized systems in regulated environments. Ability to independently assess compliance risks, define practical solutions, and provide guidance or constructive challenge to project teams. Experience with manufacturing automation or IT/OT environments, with exposure to platforms such as DeltaV, Rockwell or Siemens PLCs, process historians, or laboratory automation highly desirable. Previous experience as a CSV Lead, Validation Lead, or senior compliance representative on complex manufacturing or pharmaceutical projects is preferred. Familiarity with modern Computer Software Assurance and risk-based validation approaches. Strong stakeholder-management, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across international and cross-functional teams. skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:28e9dc28-a395-4359.title: Product Analyst
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:28e9dc28-a395-4359.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Шукаємо Product Analyst із можливістю кар'єрного переходу в Product Management В цій ролі ти будеш ключовим овнером Delivery-процесів платіжного напрямку, виводячи платіжний досвід користувачів на новий рівень Ця роль саме для тебе, якщо: - Ти - експерт з Delivery та складних проектів: чітко знаєш, як менеджерити повний цикл інтеграцій Third-Party Providers без затримок втрати якості - Ти проактивний лідер з високим рівнем ownership: чітко керуєш своєю зоною відповідальності, вмієш відокремити власні рішення і монетизувати їх у конкретний бізнес-ефект - Тобі важливо приймати ключові рішення: розвивати глобальну інфраструктуру, шукаючи точки росту, а не працювати за рутинним workflow - Маєш глибокий практичний досвід з аналітикою та гіпотезами: твій стандартний підхід до розв'язання задач будується за твердою структурою: «проблема → метрика → перевірка» - Проактивно включаєшся в Discovery: не чекаєш готових рішень, а скануєш конкурентів/ринок й знаходиш найкраще Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі: - Робота із всесвітнім масштабом транзакцій: щодня ми обробляємо десятки тисяч платежів від користувачів з усього світу (робота з усіма основними card-брендами, типами карт та банками-емітентами). Твоє завдання — керувати цим потоком та отримувати унікальний досвід з міжнародними фінансовими системами - Вплив на конверсію та дохід через розширення портфеля рішень: аналіз ефективності поточних платіжних методів для різних сегментів користувачів. Твоє завдання — бачити «вузькі місця» у конверсії, ініціювати інтеграцію більш ефективних партнерських рішень під ключ та валідувати їхній бізнес-ефект (Approval Rates, ROI) через A/B тестування - Співпраця з технологічними лідерами та worldwide network: партнерство з high-tech компаніями та проходження повного циклу інтеграцій (від тестів до live). Розбудова відносин з топ-банками та доступ до глобальної фінтех-спільноти - Самостійний Product Discovery та аналіз ринку: тут не буде готового списку платіжних рішень. Ти будеш проактивно сканувати конкурентів, аналізувати світові практики й бенчмарки, знаходити та валідувати нові рішення, аргументувати, чому саме вони принесуть бізнес-ефект - Повний менеджмент full-cycle валідації гіпотез: дизайн, розробка, тестування, аналітика та проведення складних A/B тестувань - Крос-функціональна кооперація: Operations, Analytics, Finance, Marketing - Робота з власною запатентованою системою фрод-моніторингу: управління розвинутими системами моніторингу, які допомагають виявляти та реагувати на інциденти в межах хвилини, а не годин Що для нас важливо: - Глибокий досвід у Product Management (IT) на рівні Middle+/Senior або Product Analytics із бажанням розвиватися та перейти в Product Management. - Трек-рекорд успішного доведення проектів до результату (Delivery) навіть в умовах високої невизначеності та складних викликів. Високий рівень ownership - Досвід безпосереднього впливу на продуктові та фінансові метрики: Approval Rates, Conversions, LTV, ROI, вміння рахувати Unit-економіку - Вміння проводити комплексні дослідження: аналіз конкурентів, ринку, моделей монетизації на основі реальних кейсів та глибокої аналітики - Сильна, структурована комунікація: вміння чітко арг

southparkcommons-orb:ashbyhq:38eddf8e-8e.title: Software Engineer, Pricing Lifecycle- San Francisco HQ
southparkcommons-orb:ashbyhq:38eddf8e-8e.description: About Orb: We’re a team that cares deeply about the work, the people we do it with, and the customers we do it for. Everyone at Orb has real ownership over their work, direct access to customers, and a voice in how the company grows. We’re building the revenue design platform that helps teams automate billing, evolve pricing, and grow revenue with confidence. Looking ahead, joining forces with Adyen expands what we can build and raises the ceiling on the problems we get to solve for customers. The challenges are uniquely interesting, and you’ll be surrounded by thoughtful, ambitious people who move fast and hold a high bar. For San Francisco Bay Area , New York, and Amsterdam residents, we've built a hybrid work culture where we are in office 3 days/week. For remote roles, we ask you to join us in person 1x per quarter. Our values, customer centricity, minutes matter, run with it, attention to detail, and go further together are at the core of everything we do. About the role: As an engineer at Orb, you’ll help to build the technical foundations of a critical product that needs to be reliable and accurate at scale. You’ll work closely with our customers to understand pain points in their business processes, and help incorporate those insights into our product roadmap. Our customers rely on Orb to transform an inherently complex domain (billing, from data ingestion to subscription management and revenue recognition) into an efficient, powerful, and easy-to-use experience. In this role you will: - Design and maintain core pricing lifecycle primitives with a focus on extensibility and ease of use - Evolve the product data model to balance complexity and clarity - Scale real-time ingestion and query systems for large, high-performance deployments - Collaborate cross-functionally (PM, design, sales, customer success) to shape strategy and deliver value - Learn from and contribute to a highly skilled team About you: - 5+ years of experience in software engineering - Enthusiastic about working on a broad range of technical challenges across the stack - Attention to detail in designing a product with deep user empathy (in visual UX, API design, and everything in between) - Excited to engage with customers directly to shape the Orb product - Based in the San Francisco Bay Area or willing to relocate (with support from Orb) Orb’s Tech Stack : At Orb, we believe great engineers can learn any stack, so you do not need experience with these specific tools, and we encourage you to apply regardless. - Frontend: Typescript + React + Tailwind CSS - Backend: Python - Datastores: PostgreSQL + Apache Druid+ Clickhouse - Streaming Platforms: Kafka + Spark Streaming - Cloud Platform: AWS Benefits: - Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance - One Medical membership - Unlimited PTO plus an additional week off between Christmas and New Year’s - 401k plan - 16-week paid parental leave with equity vesting - Commuter stipend - Catered lunches in the office - Annual learning & development stipend - Meaningful equity in the form of stock options Equal Opportunity Employer We work with each other day in and day out, and strongly believe that building a diverse and inclusive team is key to our long-term goals and success as a company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.
